items.text: Denver: DNP - S Talanoa Hufanga (ankle, expected to miss multiple weeks), S Brandon Jones (hamstring), CB Kris Abrams-Draine (ankle), DL Eyioma Uwazurike (shoulder). WR Pat Bryant activated from IR (full). Bo Nix starts.

Carolina: DNP - LB Jaelan Phillips (hamstring), CB Will Lee III (hamstring), G Damien Lewis (knee), LB Bobby Okereke (foot); limited - C Corey Bullock, G Torricelli Simpkins III. QB Bryce Young (ankle) full. On IR: OT Taylor Moton, OT Ikem Ekwonu, CB Jaycee Horn, CB Mike Jackson, WR Xavier Legette.
